t: 八个月大的赫拉克利乌斯·康斯坦丁被他的父亲赫拉克利乌斯在君士坦丁堡加冕为同族(Caesar).
te: Eight-month-old Heraclius Constantine is crowned as co-emperor (Caesar) by his father Heraclius at Constantinople.
